eps.d: Mini Goku is Just Precious! I'm Gohan With no new battles to fight, Goku has been living a quiet life in the countryside with his wife Chi-chi and their son Gohan! While Goku makes plans to spend a happy day with friends on Master Roshi's island, a powerful new threat is on its way to Earth. And the arrival of this sinister alien could spell disaster for Goku and his friends!

The Strongest Warrior in All of History is Goku's Brother! Goku and Gohan attend a reunion on Master Roshi's island, where Goku introduces his son to all of his old friends. The smiles quickly fade, however, as an unexpected visitor lands on the island, and for Goku the day becomes a reunion of a different kind. A powerful alien has arrived. It's Raditz, Goku's evil older brother!

Alright! This is the Strongest Combo on Earth! Raditz has kidnapped Gohan! And unless Goku agrees to forsake his friends and the people of Earth by joining the sinister Saiyan, he may never see his son again! All hope is not lost, however, as a second uninvited guest arrives on the island and Goku forges an unlikely alliance!

Piccolo's Trump Card! Gohan is a Crybaby The situation looks bleak for Goku and Piccolo, as Raditz easily deflects every attack they send his way. But Piccolo may have a way to stop the sinister Saiyan. He's perfected a powerful new attack... the Special Beam Cannon! There's only one problem.

Goku Dies! There's Only One Chance Left As Goku takes blow after punishing blow from the evil Raditz, Gohan is able to watch no longer! The young boy's rage unlocks an awesome power sleeping within him, and he unleashes a mighty attack that not even Radtiz can resist! But as quickly as Gohan's power appears, it vanishes.

Even Enma-sama is Surprised — A Fight in the Afterlife With Raditz defeated and Goku gone from this world, the surviving Z-Fighters must begin preparing for the arrival of two more Saiyans who will reach Earth in one year's time. Piccolo takes Gohan into the wild for a severe training program, in the hope that his hidden power will be revealed.

Dinosaur Survival! Gohan's Difficult Training Gohan begins his first day of Piccolo's training. Alone in the wilderness, he must quickly learn to take care of himself. But that isn't easy when he's tired, hungry -- and being chased by hungry dinosaurs! If Gohan's first day is this dangerous, how will he ever survive for the second?

The Great Transformation on a Moonlit Night! The Secret of Gohan's Power Krillin receives a startling message. Korin wants him to gather Yamcha, Tien, and Chiaotzu and report for special training! And if that weren't enough, he and Roshi still have to find a way to tell Chichi what's happened to Goku and her son. Meanwhile, Gohan's training causes him to undergo a shocking transformation!

Sorry Robot-san — The Tears that Vanished in the Desert Gohan falls into a hole in the desert and discovers a robot buried in sand in an ancient underground ruin. The robot tells him not to disturb its sleep, but Gohan, reluctantly, wakes it up again and again. As the robot looks after Gohan, it begins to get along with him.

Don't Cry Gohan! His First Fight Krillin visits Yamcha in preparation for the crisis one year from now. Yamcha, who had left martial arts to become a professional baseball player, decides to train under Kami after learning of Goku's death and the Saiyan invasion. Meanwhile, Gohan, who has been surviving in the wilderness, begins caring for an injured herbivorous dinosaur.

The Saiyan, Strongest Warriors in the Universe, Awaken! Vegeta and Nappa, two Saiyans heading to Earth, plan to plunder Planet Arlia on the way. However, the once fertile planet Arlia has become a ruined planet ruled by a dictator. The two are obediently taken to the castle, but Nappa wipes out the soldiers and easily defeats the ultimate monster weapon.

Catnap on the Serpent Road — Goku Takes a Tumble Despite being followed around by Lunch, Tenshinhan continues his training with Chiaotzu at a waterfall deep in the mountains. After hearing the story of Krillin and Bulma, he decides to undergo training from Kami. At the same time, Goku has finally made it halfway down the Snake Path.

Hands Off! Enma-sama's Secret Fruit Tenshinhan and his friends start climbing the Karin Tower to undergo training from God. At the same time, Goku slips off Snake Way while sleeping and falls into Hell. Unable to return, Goku tries to eat the fruit of the Enshou Tree, but the demons Gozu and Mezu notice him.

Such Sweet Temptation! The Snake Princess's Hospitality Krillin and the others begin their training at Kami's Lookout. Then, Goku returns to Snake Way and discovers a mansion along the way, where he is drawn in by a mysterious force. What's more, the owner of the mansion, the Snake Princess, falls in love with Goku at first sight.

Escape from Piccolo! Gohan Summons a Storm When Goku had finally traveled halfway, Gohan, who was training in the wilderness, became homesick and tried to go back home. However, no matter how much he ran along the coast after passing through the desert, he always ended up back where he started. Curious, Gohan climbed a mountain and discovered that he was on an island.

Run, Gohan! Longing for Mt. Paozu, Where Chi-Chi is Waiting Gohan is caught in a storm and thrown into the sea, where he washes up on a shore where he is rescued by some unknown children. The group is orphans who have lost their parents and are living alone in the ruins, led by the eldest, Piguero. They refuse to be placed in an orphanage and have been on the run.

City of No Tomorrow! The Long Road to Victory Piccolo and Gohan return to the wilderness and begin their training. After that, Krillin and the others, who are fed up with not receiving much training, are led to a room where all time is mixed together and are sent on a journey through time. Having traveled through time and space, the four are suddenly attacked by a mysterious duo.

Last Stop on Serpent Road! Are you Kaiō-sama? Six months have passed since the tail was cut off, and Gohan's tail has regenerated and he has once again transformed into a giant monkey! Piccolo immediately tries to destroy the moon, but no matter how much he attacks, he is unable to destroy it. Meanwhile, Goku has finally reached the end of the Snake Way.

The Battle with Gravity! Catch Bubbles-kun Goku finally meets King Kai on King Kai's planet. He somehow manages to pass the gag test (?) set by King Kai, who loves puns, and finally begins his training on King Kai's planet. He chases King Kai's pet Bubbles for three weeks in gravity ten times that of Earth.

The Return of the Saiyan Legend! Goku's Roots The next training that King Kai assigns to Goku is to hit Gregory with a hammer. Gregory is faster than Bubbles, so Goku desperately pursues him! One day, King Kai tells Goku the history of the evil Saiyans and how they were wiped out, leaving only four of them.

Come Forth, Shenlong! The Saiyans Finally Arrive on Earth Goku finishes his training on King Kai's planet and tests the power of the super technique, the Spirit Bomb, taught to him by King Kai. However, the Saiyans are approaching Earth sooner than expected. Furthermore, King Kai's miscalculation is discovered, and Goku is forced to return to the lower world in a hurry.
Unbelievable!! Saibaimen, Born from the Soil The Saiyans Vegeta and Nappa landed on Earth, searching for the one with the highest combat ability, and flew to where Piccolo and Gohan were.

Yamcha Dies! The Terror of the Saibaiman Krillin, Piccolo, and Gohan stand face to face with the sinister Saiyans and their diabolical henchmen. The villains have already proven terrifyingly powerful. Can Earth's heroes hold out until Goku arrives?

Farewell, Ten-san! Chaozu's Suicide Strategy Enraged over the loss of Yamcha, Krillin unleashes a powerful attack that destroys the maniacal Saibamen once and for all. Now Earth's defenders must battle the Saiyans themselves - starting with Nappa.

Tenshinhan Cries Out!! This is My Last Kikōhō Chiaotzu sacrifices himself to save his friends from Nappa, but when the smoke clears, the villain still stands! Luckily, Tenshinhan has one trick left that could forever silence the Saiyan warrior!

An Intense 3-Hour Delay! The Kinto-Un Bullet-Express Vegeta has called a halt to the fighting, and Nappa uses the time to go on a rampage! Meanwhile, Goku reaches the end of Snake Way and races to re-join his friends - but is he already too late?

Leave it to Me! Gohan's Great Burst of Anger Piccolo, Gohan, and Krillin do their best to stop the Saiyans from finding the Dragon Balls. Meanwhile, Goku rushes back to Earth on the Flying Nimbus, armed with more power than ever before!

Ferocity of the Saiyans! God and Piccolo Both Die! Piccolo makes the ultimate sacrifice to save Gohan from the rampaging Saiyans. Just when all seems lost, Goku returns to Earth with an incredible new level of power and confronts the invaders.

Father is Awesome! The Ultimate Finishing Technique: Kaiō-Ken Locked in battle with the Saiyans, Goku gives Nappa a brutal demonstration of the training he received from King Kai. Broken and defeated, Nappa must now face the ferocious wrath of Vegeta!

A Hot, Unbounded Battle! Goku vs Vegeta Goku decides to take on mighty Vegeta all by himself! The two appear evenly matched, but both are hiding their true strength. The epic battle is underway - which mighty warrior will claim victory?

Now, Goku! A Final Technique with Everything on the Line Vegeta and Goku continue trading brutal blows, but the action intensifies when Vegeta reveals the secret power of the Saiyans: the ability to transform into a giant, planet-destroying ape!

Battle Power Times 10!! Vegeta's Great Transformation Goku feels the brunt of Vegeta's fully-realised Saiyan power! Earth's greatest hero is left with no choice except to use the Spirit Bomb. If his attack fails, he may find himself completely doomed!

Don't Die, Father!! This is Gohan's Hidden Strength With Goku caught in the clutches of the giant ape Vegeta, Krillin attacks with his Destructo Disk! When his effort falls short, an unlikely hero steps out of the shadows!

Shoot, Kuririn! The Genki-Dama, Packed with Hope Goku passes the power of the Spirit Bomb to Krillin, who - with King Kai's guidance - launches the bomb at Vegeta. The Saiyan is sent flying into the sky, but is the evil warrior really gone for good?

Cause a Miracle! The Super Saiyan Son Gohan Vegeta is crushed beneath the full weight of Gohan's giant ape form! With the Saiyan battered and defeated, Krillin moves to finish the Saiyan with a final blow - but Goku has other plans.

We're Off Into Space! The Planet of Hope is Piccolo's Homeland The gang mourns the loss of Yamcha, Tenshinhan, Chiaotzu, and Piccolo. With Kami gone, Earth's Dragon Balls have disappeared. Will the surviving heroes find a way to wish their fallen friends back to life?

The Mysterious Yunzabit! The Search for Kami-sama's Spaceship Bulma accidentally destroys the Saiyan spaceship! Luckily, Mr. Popo reveals the existence of another ship that may be able to reach Namek. Can they find it in time, and will the old ship still work if they do?

Blast-off for Planet Namek! The Terror Awaiting Gohan and Company Goku, Krillin, and Gohan prepare for the return of the Saiyans. Meanwhile, Bulma and Mr. Popo search for a second spaceship capable of transporting her to Planet Namek.

Friends or Foes? Children of the Mysterious Giant Spaceship Gohan, Bulma, and Krillin blast off for Planet Namek in search of the magic Dragon Balls, but their journey quickly turns chaotic when they encounter a bizarre situation in the vacuum of space!

Really, for Real? There Lies Namek, Planet of Hope Bulma, Gohan, and Krillin are mistaken for friends of Frieza and taken prisoner by an angry army of children! To regain their freedom and continue on their mission, the gang must convince the kids of their innocence.

Kind-hearted Aliens — There's the Five-Star Ball Already A near-fatal crash landing turns out to have a silver lining when Bulma, Gohan, and Krillin are rescued by two friendly Namekians who agree to help them locate the seven Dragon Balls.

Planet Freeza No. 79 — Vegeta Recovers!! Gohan, Krillin, and Bulma continue their search for the Dragon Balls with the help of their new friend Zarkro. Back on Earth, Goku has escaped from the hospital to begin training for his upcoming re-match with Vegeta.

The Dragon Balls Are All Here! Piccolo-san Comes Back to Life As Bulma, Krillin, and Gohan close in on the last of the Dragon Balls, they uncover a shocking secret about their Namekian friends. Meanwhile, Goku works to build up his strength, and Vegeta sets his sights on revenge!

A Tough New Enemy! Emperor of the Universe, Freeza Bulma, Krillin, and Gohan finally continue their quest to locate all seven Dragon balls. Unfortunately, the gang soon discovers that they aren't the only ones seeking the magical balls.

Vegeta's Ambition! I am the Greatest Warrior in the Universe!! Krillin, Gohan, and Bulma are horrified to see Vegeta's space pod land on Planet Namek, but the Saiyan Prince is the least of their problems. Yet another epically evil villain has come to Namek in search of the Dragon Balls!

Goku's Power at Full-Force!! Six Days to the End of the Galaxy With the odds rapidly mounting against them, Krillin and Gohan will need some serious help if they hope to recover the Dragon Balls from Frieza and his henchmen.

Surprise Attack!! The Elder's Target was the Scouter Krillin and Gohan get their first glimpse of Frieza's cruelty as the villain unleashes his henchmen upon an unsuspecting Namek village. Frieza wants the fifth Dragon Ball, and he is prepared to learn its location by any means necessary!

Gohan in Peril! A Pursuing Dodoria Summons Death Gohan risks his life to rescue a Namek boy from the clutches of Frieza's evil henchmen. Now Gohan and Krillin have an even bigger problem on their hands: Dodoria is chasing them, and he won't stop until he has his revenge!

Dodoria Dies by Explosion! Vegeta's Fearsome Shockwave Dodoria's search for Krillin and Gohan brings him face to face with an unexpected foe - Vegeta! The Saiyan prince has a score to settle with Dodoria, and the time for a final showdown between these two powerful villains has arrived!

Escape From a Burning Planet!! A Life-or-Death Kamehameha Goku's journey to Namek takes an unexpected detour when his spaceship is knocked off course by an asteroid! Goku has to act fast to get his ship back on track because he's headed straight for the fiery centre of a star!

Courage Times One Hundred! The Warriors Gather Under Kaiō With his new abilities, Vegeta quickly tracks down and forcefully acquires another Dragon Ball. Now, there is only one magic orb left to find, and Dende knows who has it - the Eldest Namekian!

Listen to Me Goku! Hands Off Freeza King Kai becomes concerned after learning that Goku is on a collision course with the ruthless Frieza. Meanwhile, back on Planet Namek, the battle between Vegeta and Zarbon has begun!

Nothing but Goosebumps! The Handsome Warrior Zarbon's Devilish Transformation Vegeta's latest battle heats up as Zarbon reveals his true power: the ability to transform into a monstrous beast! With his increased size and strength, Zarbon seems ready to turn the lights out on the Saiyan Prince - permanently!

Defend the Planet of Hope!! Kuririn's Astonishing Power-Up When Krillin speaks to the Eldest Namekian, he gets a double surprise! Not only does he receive a Dragon Ball, but the sleeping powers within him are awoken! Will Krillin's incredible new strength be enough to save his friends?

Back from the Brink of Death — The Miracle Man, Vegeta On Kaio's planet, Tenshinhan and the others continue their training against Bubbles and Gregory, but Piccolo, who has doubts about the results of his training, is the only one who does not participate. However, when they start sparring, Piccolo is surprised at how much Yamcha's skills have improved since before.

An Enormous Battle Power!! Freeza's Strategy is Shattered Vegeta steals the Dragon Ball from Freeza's spaceship and escapes! In an attempt to collect them all at once, he chases Krillin, who rushes to Bulma with the last one, but Zarbon, who notices the chase, appears and they are on the brink of an explosive confrontation.

I'm Back to My Old Self Again!! Goku Takes on 100 Times Gravity Vegeta, who is after Krillin's Dragon Ball, and Zarbon, who has been chasing him, meet again. However, Vegeta easily defeats Zarbon after he transforms. Resigned to his strength, Krillin hands over the last Dragon Ball.

Freeza's Secret Weapon! The Devilish Ginyu Special Squadron The Ginyu Special Forces launch from Planet Freeza! At their destination, Planet Namek, Gohan returns to Bulma with the Dragon Ball, but is discovered by Vegeta. However, Gohan quickly hides the Dragon Ball from Vegeta, and without a moment's rest, he rushes to the Elder's house with Krillin to have his potential unlocked.

Bulma, Watch Out!! The Four-Star Ball Falls into Freeza's Hands Freeza unleashes a gigantic blast of energy that shakes the earth, causing Bulma's four-star ball to fall into the sea. Bulma hurriedly dives into the sea in a submarine and confronts a giant crab guarding the Dragon Ball and countless eggs.

Charge!! The Kaiō-Ken and Kamehameha of an Indomitable Spirit Freeza's subordinates hear Bulma's story and start plotting to get the Dragon Balls for themselves. Bulma tricks them into thinking there are still Dragon Balls remaining in the ocean and takes them on a tour of the ocean in a submarine, but her lie is exposed along the way!

The Great Battle Approaches! The Ginyu Special Squadron Takes the Stage!! After successfully completing his training, Goku rests on the spaceship in preparation for the final battle on Planet Namek. Meanwhile, Krillin and Gohan finally arrive at the Elder's place, where they encounter Vegeta. They manage to draw out Gohan's power, but it is no match for Vegeta's.

Goku on Final Approach! Smash through Freeza's Dragnet The Ginyu Force finally arrives on Planet Namek. The only way to defeat them is to make Vegeta immortal with the power of the Dragon Balls... Krillin and the others work with Vegeta to collect the Dragon Balls, but then the Ginyu Force appears.

Is This Some Super-Magic or Just a Trick!? Mr. Gurd is Angry! The battle with the Ginyu Force begins, as Gohan and Krillin launch a barrage of explosive energy blasts at Guldo! The Heroes are rendered helpless by Guldo's Mind Blind technique, and this time, there is no one to save them!

The Savage Reacoom! The Bad, Strong, and Outrageous Guy After defeating Guldo with a surprise attack, Vegeta faces off against Recoome. Vegeta launches a preemptive attack at full power, but even an attack with a battle power of 20,000 is ineffective against Recoome. Vegeta is left on the brink of death by the powerful attack.

Don't Die, Gohan! Goku Finally Touches Down on the Battlefield Having collected all seven Dragon Balls, Freeza heads to the Elder to find out how to grant his wish. Meanwhile, Gohan attacks Recoome. He fights with all his might, but Recoome doesn't look too worried.

Uncommon Strength!! The Legendary Super Saiyan, Son Goku Finally, Goku arrives. Understanding the entire situation, Goku gives Senzu Beans not only to Gohan and Krillin, but also to Vegeta. After making sure that the three are well, Goku goes up against Recoome by himself. Krillin and the others are worried that Goku is too calm, but Goku defeats Recoome with just one blow.

Lightning Balls of Red and Blue! Jheese and Butta Attack Goku Jeice and Burter let their guard down when they see Goku's power level of 5,000 on their scouter, and begin their attack. However, even when the two of them launch direct attacks using their boastworthy speed, they are unable to land a single blow.

At Last, a Direct Confrontation!! Captain Ginyu Takes the Field In order to get Jeice and Burter to back off, Goku knocks Burter unconscious with one blow, showing the difference in their strength. Frightened by Goku's power, Jeice flies off to Commander Ginyu. Vegeta, infuriated that Jeice had escaped, finishes off Burter and Recoome, and berates Goku for being too soft on him.

Incredible Force!! Did You See It, Goku's Full Power? As the battle between Goku and Captain Ginyu rages on, Gohan and Krillin steal the unguarded Dragon Balls from Frieza's ship. It's a race against time, and our heroes must unlock the power of the Dragon Balls before it's too late!

What of the Battle's Outcome?! Freeza's Evil Hand Closes Around the Eldest Goku astounds Captain Ginyu with his amazing new powers, but the Captain still has a few tricks up his sleeve! Meanwhile, Frieza arrives at the home of the Eldest Namek and begins a battle with the noble warrior, Nail!

eps.t: Goku is Ginyu and Ginyu is Goku
eps.d: Surprise!! Goku is Ginyu and Ginyu is Goku In an attempt to save the Elder, Nail fights a hopeless battle against the ruthless Frieza. Meanwhile, finding himself no match for Goku's superior abilities, Captain Ginyu unleashes his ultimate attack, the Body Switch Technique!

Come Forth, Super Shenlong!! Grant Me My Wish Armed with the Dragon Radar, Gohan and Krillin recover the seven Dragon Balls from their hiding places. But before they can summon the Eternal Dragon to make their wish, they are confronted by a powerful new enemy - Goku?!

That Ain't Me! Gohan, Don't Lose Your Nerve, Hit Your Father!! After taking control of Goku's body, Captain Ginyu turns his attention to Gohan and Krillin! With Goku trapped in the Captain's broken body, it's up to Gohan to stop the rampaging Ginyu!

A Huge Miscalculation!! Ginyu Has Turned into a Frog As the bout between Captain Ginyu and Vegeta heats up, Goku summons the last of his strength and tricks his foe into reversing the Body Switch Technique. Now, Goku, Krillin, and Gohan must join forces with Vegeta for the battle with Frieza.

The Tide Suddenly Turns!! Piccolo, the Warrior Who Came Late Vegeta witnesses Gohan's attack, but is unable to do anything due to the vast difference in strength. Just as Frieza is about to finish off Gohan, Krillin's Kienzan cuts Frieza's tail. Frieza is puzzled, and Krillin provokes him, running away. Dende takes advantage of the opportunity to rush over to Gohan. What power does Dende possess?

Piccolo's Self-Confidence! I Will Be the One to Defeat Freeza Piccolo quickly takes control of the battle with Frieza, and the putrid purple monster is shocked to learn the secret behind his opponent's powers!

Sally Forth, Goku!! A Furious Freeza's 2nd Transformation Just as it appears that Piccolo has gained the upper hand, Frieza quickly dashes all hopes for victory by revealing his second monstrous transformation!
Fear Me!! Freeza Does Battle With a 3rd Transformation Unable to watch as Piccolo is overwhelmed by Frieza, Gohan springs into action! Meanwhile, Vegeta devises a risky plan.

The Death of Dende... Come Forth! Intense, Full-Force Power Having reached his ultimate form, Frieza is determined to destroy the remaining Z-fighters one by one, but Vegeta boldly announces the end of Frieza's reign.

The Moment We've Waited For!!! Son Goku is Revived Vegeta, who firmly believes himself to be a Super Saiyan, fires off a full-power energy blast at Frieza, but it is easily deflected with a kick. He despairs at the overwhelming difference in power. Shedding tears, he experiences failure for the first time in his life...
Such Regret…!! The Proud Saiyan, Vegeta Dies Goku rejoins his friends on the battlefield, but not before Vegeta is defeated by Frieza!

The Curtain Opens on the Super Decisive Battle!! I Am Going to Defeat You Goku wages war on the monstrous Frieza! As the fight intensifies, Frieza directs his energy blasts at Namek itself, turning the planet into a lava-spewing warzone.

The Two Great Superpowers Collide! A Physical Battle Where Both Get Serious!!! Goku and Frieza continue their epic battle! An underwater attack puts Goku on top until Frieza traps him in an energy ball!
Freeza's Terrible Declaration! I Will Defeat You Without Using My Hands Frieza vows to beat Goku without using his hands.
That Ain't No Bluff!! The Audaciously Wonderful Guy, Son Goku Captain Ginyu returns to the battlefield in Bulma's body!
Showdown!! The Embodiment of Flame in a 20-Fold Kaiō-Ken Kamehameha Goku's powerful Kaio-Ken attack has no effect on Frieza.
An Extra-Large Genki-Dama — This is the Final Trump Card!! Once again, Goku is rescued by a vision!
Seize the Chance!! Piccolo's Suicide Support Strike Yamcha, Tenshinhan, and Chiaotzu find themselves in serious trouble when the Ginyu Force invades King Kai's planet!
The Incredible Destructive Force of the Genki-Dama!! Who Will Survive?! Chaos erupts on King Kai's planet as the Z-fighters battle the Ginyu Force!

Transformed At Last!! The Legendary Super Saiyan, Son Goku A victory celebration comes to a halt when Frieza reappears! With no reserves left, Goku watches helplessly as Frieza directs his fury at Piccolo and Krillin.
An Explosion of Anger!! Goku, Avenge Everyone's Deaths Engulfed in golden light, Goku announces that he is now a Super Saiyan.

The Destruction of Planet Namek?! A Demonic Flash Penetrates the Ground Finding himself no match for Goku, Frieza attacks Planet Namek! Unable to react in time, Goku is forced to watch helplessly as the fiery blast rips through the planet.
I Am Going To Win… Risking Survival, A Final Attack With only minutes to go before the planet explodes, Frieza reaches his maximum power!
Shenlong, Fly Through Space!! The Time of Namek's Destruction Draws Near The battle between Goku and Frieza rages on! Back on Earth, the seven Dragon Balls have been restored.
I am Son Goku's Son!! Gohan Returns to the Battlefield Frieza's victims have been wished back to life, but as they begin to rise, Goku falls - overwhelmed by Frieza's devastating assault.
I'm Staying on This Planet!! A Final Wish Toward Victory The Eldest and the people of Namek have been brought back to life, and the dragon Porunga has reappeared to grant the last of three wishes.
Let's Get It On!! Two Remain on a Vanishing Planet Goku chooses to stay behind and finish his fight with Frieza.
Pathos of Freeza! Once He Starts Shaking He's Unstoppable!! Time grows short for Goku as each passing second brings Namek closer to destruction.

Goku's Declaration of Victory!! As Freeza Destroys Himself… Frieza lashes out in a blind rage, launching a reckless volley of energy attacks. In the face of Goku's superior power, the evil tyrant's greatest fear has come true.

Freeza Defeated!! A Single Blast Packed With a Totality of Rage Learning that the Namekian Dragon Balls can revive humans many times, Gohan and the others let out a cry of joy. Now they can bring Krillin and Chiaozu back to life. On Namek, Goku's crushing victory brings an end to the deadly battle. However, as Goku leaves, Freeza strikes the final blow...

Planet Namek's Great Explosion!! Goku Disappears into Space Even though it looks like Goku is trapped on the exploding planet Namek, Dende has a good reason to celebrate: the Dragon Balls have the power to bring Goku back to life.

Son Goku Survived — The Z Warriors Are All Resurrected!! It is a time of joyful reunions as old friends long absent are finally wished home with the Dragon Balls! Krillin and Yamcha are brought back from the spirit realm.
Terrible Happenings in Heaven!! Garlic Jr. Becomes God?! Gohan's going fishing, Krillin's found a girlfriend, and it looks as though peace has once again returned to the Earth.
Black Mist of Terror…!! Everyone Turns Demonic Garlic Junior releases the Black Water Mist upon an unsuspecting world. As the dreaded fog spreads, so does Garlic Junior's control over the Earth!
The Heavens Become the Battlefield!! Piccolo Becomes Devilish Again… As Piccolo attempts to hold off the Spice Boys and the infected Z Fighters, Gohan and Krillin race toward Kami's Lookout.

Restore Everyone's Minds!! The Ultra Holy Water Resting in the Temple Krillin, after suffering a Spice Boys beating, attempts to free Kami and Mr. Popo, but he soon falls prey to the Black Water Mist.
It Can't Wait Until Morning!! Kami-sama Decides on a Suicidal Course of Action Piccolo and Krillin spring their trap, revealing that they have pretended to be infected by the Black Water Mist!

A Battle of Extreme Measures!! Kami-sama Breaks the Covenant Garlic Junior and his Spice Boys harness the evil power of the Makyo Star to become stronger than ever, but Gohan, Krillin, and Piccolo are ready to battle.
The Ultra Holy Water Worked!! The World Awakens From its Nightmare In a last ditch effort to save his friends, Gohan launches an all out assault.
Gohan's Brief Chance for Victory!! Destroy Planet Makyō… Blinded by rage and desperate to destroy his enemies, Garlic Junior uses his power to open up the Dead Zone!
You're My Guy… Kuririn — The 101st Proposal Krillin faces his toughest challenge ever: surviving a shopping trip with Maron! And it looks like she's picking out a wedding dress!
That's Earth, Papa… Freeza and his Father Strike Back Gohan's cracking the books, and his new tutor is cracking the whip!
I Will Defeat Freeza… The Mysterious Boy Awaiting Goku The Earth faces its darkest hour as Frieza and his father King Cold rapidly approach!
Freeza Halved By a Single Blow!! Another Super Saiyan Frieza and King Cold descend upon the Earth, but a mysterious warrior has come to thwart their diabolical plot for revenge.
Heya!! It's Been a While… Son Goku Returns After defeating Frieza and King Cold, the mysterious stranger announces the exact time and place of Goku's arrival on Earth.
My Dad is Vegeta… Confessions of the Mysterious Boy After testing Goku in combat, the mysterious stranger reveals his true identity!

Goku's New Finishing Technique?! Watch This, My Instantaneous Movement The future has been written - or has it? That's what Goku and the rest of the Z-Fighters must decide as they hear Trunks' ominous warning.
I Will Overcome… Goku!! The King of the Saiyan Warrior Race Gohan learns some new tricks, Vegeta pushes himself to the breaking point, and Yamcha struggles just to keep up.
License Mastery? Goku's Newest Trial Goku and Piccolo take a day off from training to enroll in driving school. These two mighty warriors may be the Earth's only chance for survival.

Murderers Who Leave No Trace — Which Ones Are the Artificial Humans?! The Androids are here, and they're wreaking havoc on an unsuspecting city! Goku and his friends must now put their training to the test!
The Cold-Blooded No. 20's Hideous Atrocities!! Goku's Super Transformation of Anger Yamcha is held at the mercy of the ruthless No. 20, and Goku and the others must race to help their friend.
Goku's Double-Shock!! Caught Between Illness and Adversary The battle with the Androids begins as Goku launches an all out assault against #19. The Super Saiyan seems to have the fight under control.

The Might of Vegeta!! The Blood of a Super Saiyan Awakens Attacked from within by a crippling virus, Goku is helpless against the maniacal #19. But just when it looks like the end for Goku, Vegeta appears on on the scene.
No. 20's Defiant Smile… The Secret of Doctor Gero In his first fight as a Super Saiyan, Vegeta takes control of the battlefield.
A Present More Terrifying Than the Future?! Trunks' Suspicions Vegeta, Piccolo, and Gohan lead an exhaustive search through the mountains for #20. But the hunters are also the hunted!

Trunks and Krillin join Bulma at the crash site of the mysterious time capsule and find an eerie clue: the shell of a large, locust-like creature! Whatever arrived in the time capsule isn't human, and it's on the loose!

An insect-like monster threatens to turn Gingertown into a ghastly graveyard! In response to this new menace, Kami fuses with Piccolo, and the resulting Super Namekian flies to Gingertown for a showdown of epic proportions!

Gingertown becomes a battlefield as Piccolo confronts Cell. This monster from the future gains his strength by sucking the life out of his victims! But that's not the creature's only talent. He also knows the Kamehameha Wave!

A Life Form of Evil and Destruction!! His Name is Artificial Human Cell Heavily-armored tanks fail to halt Cell's rampage, and now it's up to Piccolo to stop the monster! As the Namekian fights for survival, Cell reveals that he's actually an android, the ultimate achievement of Dr. Gero!

Piccolo's Grievous Mistake! Cell Escapes Into the City! Piccolo cleverly distracts Cell long enough to regenerate his arm. The Namekian is ready for another round, and Krillin and Trunks have arrived to provide backup! With the odds mounting against him, Cell makes a tactical decision.

The Secret of Cell's Birth! What Lies Below the Laboratory?! With hopes of saving the future, Trunks and Krillin race to destroy Dr. Gero's lab. Meanwhile, Piccolo and Tien search for the elusive Cell. But how can they stop an enemy who knows their every move?

Goku Awakens to Battle! Go Beyond the Super Saiyan!! In South City, Cell plows through more civilians and accidentally runs into Krillin! Goku finally gets back on his feet, but with Cell and the other androids in full stride, can the Saiyan hero still make a difference?

Hasten Your Training, Saiyans! In the Room of Spirit and Time… As Cell continues his deadly march, Goku hatches a plan to squeeze a year's worth of training into just one day! Back at Master Roshi's, the android trio arrives looking for Goku! Can Piccolo hold them off until the Saiyans return?

The Gekiretsu Kodan that Split the Heavens!! Piccolo vs Artificial Human No. 17 Behind the closed doors of the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, Vegeta and Trunks struggle to push past the level of Super Saiyan! Down on Earth, Piccolo challenges Android 17 to a battle!

How I Have Waited For this Day!! Cell's Prologue to Perfection Stronger than ever after fusing with Kami, Piccolo leads the attack against the androids! It looks like the Super Namekian has things under control until Cell arrives on the battlefield! Can anyone stop this hideous monster?!

The Suicidal Counterattack Proves Ineffective! Piccolo's Flame Burns Out!! Just as Cell is about to absorb Android 17, Piccolo bravely steps in and foils the monster's plan! Does the Super Namekian really have a chance at stopping Cell on his own?! Or is he simply putting off the inevitable?

One Final Remaining Hope… The Silent Warrior No. 16 Takes Action!! When Android 16 claims to be as strong as Cell, it seems like a wild boast! But after he launches an offensive that throws Cell against the ropes, it becomes clear that the big android has the power to back up his words!

No. 17 is Swallowed… The Transforming Cell is a Super Gourmet It's android against android as 16 clashes with Cell. Android 16 is the stronger fighter, but Cell is far too driven to be stopped now! With an underheanded attack, Cell moves one step closer to his gruesome transformation!

Tomorrow I am Going to Pulverize You!! Goku's Challenge With an onslaught of psychic blasts, Tien gives Androids 16 and 18 a chance to escape, but the powerful attack rapidly drains his strength. Tien may have saved the androids, but can he save himself?

I'll Finish Everything!! A Reborn Vegeta, Father and Son, Sally Forth Trunks and Vegeta emerge from the time chamber after a year of intense training. Goku and Gohan are next into the room, but with Cell nearing his ultimate form, can the fighters afford to wait another day?

Suddenly Full-Throttle!! The Radiant Vegeta's Super Power Cell obliterates a chain of islands in search of Android 18! Vegeta, fresh from the time chamber, is ready to test his new strength against the monster, but is he really stronger than a Super Saiyan?
On Your Knees, Cell! I am Super Vegeta!! Vegeta shows cell his new power while Goku and Gohun train.

A Shock to the Entire Universe!! Cell, A Spectacular Evolution Toward His Perfect Form With the remote control smashed, Krillin and Trunks must save Android 18 from Cell's power-hungry grasp. But Vegeta has other plans in mind. Will trunks attack his own father to save humanity?

An Infinite Battle Power!! The Birth of the God of Destruction is Named Cell The earth's greatest fear has come true: Cell is complete! Can anyone stop the android nightmare in his final, perfect form? As the heroes nervously line up, a glimmer of hope shines from above. Gohan is a Super Saiyan!

Super Vegeta in Peril!! An Absolutely Perfect Terror Closes In!! After allowing Cell to reach his final form, Vegeta is ready for the challenge he was promised. But as Cell easily deflects the Saiyan's every blow, it's clear that Vegeta has more his hands than he bargained for!

Breaking Through the Boundaries of the Super Saiyan!! Trunks Summons a Storm Tapping into the deepest wells of his energy, Vegeta summons one last attack: the Final Flash! Meanwhile, Trunks struggles to decide whether or not to help his father. Vegeta's pride is at stake, but so is his life!

Save Your Father!! Trunks' Fury, Which Scorches Even the Heavens Vegeta lies unconscious after his battle with Cell, and Trunks unleashes his hidden powers to save his father's life. With Goku and Gohan still training, Trunks is the only person standing in the evil android's way.

A Future of Despair!! Trunks, the Man Who Lived Through Hell Trunks vows to stop the future from repeating itself; Cell can't wait for the future to unfold. It's all up for grabs as the two warriors prepare for battle. Only one future will survive. Whose will it be?

Super Trunks Has a Weakness!! Cell, A Shocking Bombshell Declaration Realizing that his powers are no match for his opponent, Trunks accepts defeat, only to be given a second chance when Cell proposes a tournament! Is Cell really interested in competition, or does he have a sinister motive?

Dende's New Occupation!! The Dragon Balls are Revived With help from King Kai, Goku travels to Namek to recruit a new guardian for the Earth! Most of the Namekians refuse the offer, but there's one little guy who can't wait to go! Dende is back, and he's going to create a new Dragon!

Goku's Perplexing Problem?! The Dragon Balls are Taken Back Goku comes face to face with an old adversary: General Tao! The search for the Dragon Balls led Goku to the aging general, but unless the Super Saiyan can solve the crafty villain's puzzle, the search may end in vain!

Cell's Standing Challenge!! The Opening to the Decisive Battle The wait is over, and the Cell Games are ready to begin! The Z-Fighters arrive ringside, only to discover another challenger already on the scene. It's none other than World Martial Arts Champion, Mr. Satan!

Wait Just a Minute!! The Great Satan Army Arrives Caroni and Pirozhki, Mr. Satan's top students, make a spectacular entrance to the ring, but are they really ready to rumble with Cell? Don't miss a minute of the fun, because this fight could be over fast!
Goku's Bout!! The Super-Tense Cell Games Goku and Cell start fighting with each other in the ring. If Cell wins then he'll destroy the earth. If Goku wins then the Cell will give up.

A Direct Hit to the Earth!! Cell's Huge Kamehameha Cell attacks Goku with a dazzling array of moves including the Destructo Disk, the Special Beam Cannon, and even the Kamehameha Wave! Goku matches the monster blow for blow, but how long can he last against such a lethal arsenal?

Lose or Die?! Goku, A Secret Turnabout Plan As the battle intensifies, Cell quickly grows tired of the rules he created for the tournament. With a flick of his finger, the Android destroys the ring, instantly turning the Cell Games into a deadly fight to the finish!

The End of the Desperate Struggle!! Goku Surrenders?! Goku blasts Cell with a Kamehameha Wave that reduces the android to a pile of cinders, but his triumph is short-lived. The monster shows his amazing resilience by fully regenerating himself!

Someone Who Will Succeed the Strongest… His Name is Gohan After surrendering to Cell, Goku names the next challenger to enter the Cell Games: Gohan! Goku has supreme faith in his son's abilities, but the young Saiyan will need a lot more than his father's confidence if he's going to survive!

Get Angry, Gohan—Release the Dormant Power Within The fight between Gohan and Cell intensifies, but the villain's attacks seem to have no effect on the boy! Could the young hero really have the power to defeat the evil android once and for all?

Miniature Threats!! The Cell Juniors Attack Cell is determined to unleash Gohan's full potential, but the boy refuses to fight, prompting the android to torture Gohan's friends instead! Next, Cell does the unthinkable by spawning miniature Cells to attack the Z-Fighters!

The Tragedy of No. 16!! Super Gohan's Anger Explodes Gohan boils with rage as the Cell Juniors wreak havoc on the Z-Fighters. The boy struggles to resist the urge to fight, but he's a powder keg waiting to explode, and Android 16 appears ready to light the fuse!
Anger Exploding Into Power!! The Cell Juniors are Destroyed "The Unleashing" - After Android 16 tells Gohan to unleash his powers. Gohan becomes super sayan and starts destroying cells children.

Cell is Knocked Out!! Taken Down With Two Super Punches Cell's desire for battle turns into a nightmare as Gohan unleashes the full fury of his strength. The evil android powers up to his maximum level, but will it be enough to spare him from the wrath of Super Saiyan?
Cell's Disaster!! The Destruction of His Perfect Form Gohan's Super Saiyan strength appears to have no limit, and the young hero delivers a blow so severe it causes Cell to cough up Android 18!

Bye-Bye Everyone!! Goku's Last Instant Movement Clearly overmatched by Gohan, Cell initiates his last line of defense: a self-destruct program that will blow up the entire planet! With only seconds to spare, Goku risks everything to transport Cell away from the Earth.

The Nightmare is Reborn!! An Absolute and Perfect Terror The nightmare continues! Cell explodes, but a particle of his nucleus survives the blast, providing all the android needs to regenerate himself! Restored to his ultimate form, Cell returns to the Earth more powerful than ever!

From Goku to Gohan… A Father's Spirit is Passed Down Vegeta lashed out against Cell but was incapacitated in a single blow. Gohan jumps in front to save Vegeta and is wounded in the process. Cell and Gohan unleash their devastating Kamehameha waves as they collide in a fierce beam struggle.

The Fight is Over… Thank You, Son Goku The final showdown begins! While Goku telepathically coaches Gohan from the Other World, the Z-Fighters jump in for a five-sided attack! Gohan has the potential inside him, but can Goku show him how to unlock it?

I Will Carry On in the Afterlife!! Farewell with a Smile Cell is finally defeated, but the Z-Fighters still have much to resolve! Can they make it to the Lookout in time to heal the badly-injured Gohan? Is Android 18 still a threat? And can our heroes find a way to bring back Goku?
A New Day Will Come… Father! I'll Hang in There With one more wish left, what shall the Z-Fighters wish for?
Peace and order have been restored on Earth in the present, but Trunks' future world is still a place of darkness and despair! Once he arrives home, the future will be forever changed!

When Goku hears about a martial arts master known as the Grand Kai, he rushes to meet him for a lesson! Meanwhile, Cell, Frieza, King Cold and the Ginyu Force have teamed up to take control of Other World!

Goku must train for 10,000 years before he can study under the Grand Kai! But when the West, South, and East Kaiâ€ôs decide to hold an Other World Tournament, Goku gets his chance! All he has to do is defeat the greatest fighters of all time!

The Other World Tournament advances to the Quarter-Finals, and the battles are out of this world! Goku's opponent, Arqua, appears to be a wimp, but things change quickly when he transforms the entire ring into water!

Goku advances to the final round of the tournament where he will face the warrior Pikkon! Sparks of energy fly as the brawlers battle for the title! When Pikkon reveals a Piccolo-like secret, Goku must up the ante! It's Super Saiyan time!

Goku may be a Super Saiyan, but can he withstand Pikkon's unbelievable Thunder Flash Attack?! And that's not all! While Goku's been fighting in Other World, seven years have passed on Earth, Gohan is now a teenager!

7 Years Since That Event! Starting Today, I'm a High Schooler On his first day of high school, Gohan stops a truckload of bank robbers by turning Super Saiyan. Now, the city can't stop talking about this mysterious "Gold Fighter!" Can Gohan get through class without revealing his secret identity?

The Champion and Lover of Justice — The Great Saiyaman Appears Afraid he will be recognized by his classmates, Gohan gets Bulma to design a retractable super-hero costume that he can activate in an instant. Say goodbye to Gohan - and hello to Saiyaman.

Gohan's Confusing First Date?! Gohan thinks being a super-hero is a snap until a pretty girl named Angela discovers his secret. When Angela threatens to tell all unless he goes on a date with her, Gohan's life suddenly becomes more complicated than ever!

Gohan, Get Moving Quick! Rescue Videl!! When the Red Shark Gang kidnaps the mayor and demands a showdown with Mr. Satan, it's Videl who answers the challenge. Gohan knows Videl is in over her head, but he can't leave his classroom to help her without blowing his cover!

A Robbery Case!! The Culprit is Saiyaman?! When a greedy circus promoter kidnaps a baby dinosaur, all he sees are dollar signs! Little does he know, that the dinosaur is a close, personal friend of the Great Saiyaman!

Goku's Also Resurrected?! He's Participating in the Tenka'ichi Budōkai!! The Great Saiyaman is about to become a movie star but the hero's brush with stardom better not take long, because he has to hurry up and tell all of his old friends the big news: Goku is coming back.

Even Gohan is Surprised! Goten's Explosion of Power While training for the upcoming tournament, Gohan discovers that Goten has already reached the level of Super Saiyan! Sparks fly when the brothers spar, but the main event happens when Videl meets Chichi for the first time!

Ah, I Flew!! Videl's Introduction to Flight With the Tournament fast approaching, Videl and Goten must learn to fly! Miles away, Vegeta holds a training session of his own, and his young son, Trunks, has a big surprise in store for him

Welcome Back, Goku! The Whole Z Team Assembles!! Videl learns to fly, and Gohan and Goten do some last minute honing of their Super Saiyan skills. On the island where the tournament will be held, a special guest arrives! What do you say to a hero who's been dead for seven years?!
You're in Danger, Saiyaman! Guard Yourself Against a Perfectly Timed Photo?! Everyone qualifies for the World Tournament.

No Small Matter!! Little Trunks The action begins as the World Martial Arts Tournament opens with the Junior Division! Thirty-five young fighters vie for the prize, but the matches prove to be more comedy than competition - until Trunks steps into the ring!

It's My Turn!! Goten's Anxious First Fight Goten and Trunks breeze through the Junior Division of the tournament until they find themselves going head-to-head in the finals! Who will win this exciting match? This is one championship fight you won't want to miss!

Happiness Times a Million! The Junior Champion is Decided!! The match for the Junior Division World Championship continues as Goten and Trunks battle for the title! The winner of this final joust becomes the new World Champion! Can Goten outwit the cunning Trunks?

Now What, Satan?! The Greatest Pinch in History After winning the championship, Trunks fights an exhibition match against Mr. Satan! Can the Champ hold on to his reputation as the world's strongest fighter? Meanwhile, two mysterious figures reveal themselves to Goku!

The Match-Ups Are Decided!! Hurry and Hold the First Round Trunks and Gohan infiltrate the adult competition at the tournament by donning the disguise of Mighty Mask. The pairings for the day matches are selected. The first to fight: Krillin vs. Pintar, a man easily ten times Krillins size!

What's the Matter, Piccolo?! An Unheard-of No-Fight Forfeit Piccolo stuns the crowd by surrendering to his mysterious opponent before the first punch is thrown! Next into the ring is Videl, who must face the enormous Spopovitch. Will she be able to handle such a large job?

Undyingly Unpleasant?! The Mystery of Spopovitch Videl takes to the ring for what is expected to be an easy victory over Spopovitch. She hits the towering brute with everything shes got, but her attacks have no effect. It seems Spopovitch is possessed by a supernatural power!

A Tragic Videl!! Are You Coming Out, Angry Super Gohan? To everyones horror, Spopovitch delays his inevitable victory for the purposes of torturing Videl! It appears the muscle-bound thug isn't going to stop until he kills her! Will Videl make it out of the ring alive?

Exposed!! The Saiyaman is Son Gohan Gohan's identity is finally discovered as he takes his place on the tournament floor, but he has bigger things to worry about. His opponent, Kibito, is determined to see him transform into a Super Saiyan!

A Slithering Conspiracy!! Gohan's Power is Stolen When Gohan transforms into a Super Saiyan, Spopovitch and Yamu spring into action! Armed with a mysterious energy-draining device, the pair launch an attack on the golden-haired teen.

The Man Behind the Curtain Appears!! The Evil Mage Babidi The Z-Fighters race to stop Babidi's cronies from delivering the pure energy that will be used resurrect the dreaded Majin Buu. Will they find Babidis hidden spaceship in time?

The Awaiting Trap!! A Challenge From the Demon Realm Piccolo and Krillin are turned to stone by Dabura! Determined to save their friends, Goku, Gohan, and Vegeta board Babidi's ship only to find themselves trapped! Can they save their friends and find their way out?

Don't Toy With Me!! Vegeta Breaks Through the First Fight in a Fury At each stage of Babidi's ship, Goku, Gohan, and Vegeta must face a fearsome warrior, each more powerful than the last. There's no room for error. Even the tiniest mistake will enable Babidi to steal their energy for Majin Buu.

Goku's Power Wide Open!! Blow Away Yakon Babidi unleashes his monster Yakon to steal the Z-Fighters' energy for Majin Buu. The battle at Stage Two is sure to be intense, as Yakon is one of the most fearsome creatures in the universe!

A Great Miscalculation!! Satan vs Three Super Warriors?! At the World Martial Arts Tournament, the five remaining competitors enter the ring for an all-out Battle Royale! The fists fly as Number 18, Mighty Mask, and Mr. Satan duke it out to decide who will be the next Champion of the World!

Such Strong Kids!! No. 18's Close Fight?! The battle heats up as Number 18 and Mighty Mask take their fight to the skies. Number 18 gives it everything she's got, but her attacks prove useless against her masked opponent. Could she find the edge she needs to win?

A Confrontation With the Demon King! It's Your Turn Gohan!! As the final bout of the tournament continues, Number 18 throws the defending champ for a loop by offering to throw the fight! Meanwhile, Babidi has selected his warrior for Stage 3: Dabura, King of the Demon World!

A Wicked Heart is Discovered!! Dabura's Good Idea The intense battle between Gohan and Dabura rages on, but just as the Stage 3 clash reaches a heated peak, Dabura stops the fight! Why has the evil giant conceded, and what is the great discovery he claims to have made?

Vegeta, the Prince of Destruction, is Revived!! Intrusion at the Tournament In an all-out assault against Vegeta, Babidi uses his power to undo the unsuspecting Prince from within! Vegeta is stripped of his good qualities by the wicked wizard, and becomes the heartless warrior that he once was!
A Super Confrontation of Destiny!! The Clash of Goku vs Vegeta Goku has no choice but to accept Vegeta's challenge.

Just You Wait, Babidi!! Your Aspirations Will Not be Allowed The battle between Goku and Vegeta has begun! With Babidi's magic enhancing his already incredible strength, Vegeta matches Goku move for move, but every blow the Saiyan Prince lands is a boost for Majin Buu!

The Seal is Broken! Out Comes the Vicious Majin Buu!! Gohan and the Supreme Kai confront Babidi in the depths of his space ship. With the fight between Goku and Vegeta supplying vast quantities of energy for Majin Buu, with not a moment to lose.

I Won't Allow the Revival!! A Kamehameha of Resistance The seal encasing Buu is finally broken! Supreme Kai insists on retreat, but Gohan refuses, launching an incredible series of energy attacks. When the shell opens, nothing is inside! Gohan, however, there is no time to celebrate..

A Straight Line to Despair?! The Grief of Kaiōshin With his big pink belly and infantile behavior, Buu doesn't fit the bill of a galaxy destroyer - until he hurls Dabura into a cliff with a single blow! Gohan senses a limitless power, and the Supreme Kai insists this is the end!

Supreme Kai must use his unique fighting powers to keep Buu at bay - or lose his life! One mile away, Goten and Trunks stumble upon Piccolo, still frozen in stone, and accidentally shatter him to pieces! And there's more! The King of Demons returns!

Free from the grip of Babidi, Vegeta decides to seek his revenge by destroying the monster Majin Buu. Assuming Gohan to be a victim of the voracious villain, the Super Saiyan goes ballistic. Can Vegeta bring down Buu?

A Warrior's Resolution!! I Will Dispose of the Majin The battle between Prince of Destruction Vegeta and Buu has begun! Vegeta is forced into a tough fight like never before as Buu shows no signs of taking any damage even after a hole is pierced in his stomach.
For Those Whom He Loves… Vegeta Perishes!! After fighting with Majin Buu, Vegeta realizes he isn't fighting for just himself, but for the entire planet, and commits the ultimate sacrifice.

The Nightmare Revisited! Majin Buu has Survived Majin Buu's flesh is scattered on the battlefield, but his mystical power is rebuilding the monster into one deadly piece. Babidi is recovering, too, having narrowly survived Piccolo's attack.
The Struggle of Videl and the Others! Find the Dragon Balls Videl, Yamcha, Master Roshi, Chi Chi and Bulma find the last Dragon Ball... then it gets eaten by a dinosaur.

Enormous Hope!! A New Finishing Technique for the Little Squirts Goku hatches a plan for defeating Majin Buu: Fusion! By joining two fighters of equal size and strength, an entirely new fighter can be created. But only one such pair remains-Goten and Trunks! Can the young half-Saiyans save the world?

Goten and Trunks — The World's Most Wanted Babidi seeks vengeance against Piccolo, Goten, and Trunks! Plastering images on everyone's mind, Babidi threatens to terrorize humanity until the trio is brought forward! Meanwhile, Gohan is taken to Supreme Kai's world!

Gohan is Revived — Kaiōshin's Secret Weapon?! Goku begins training Goten and Trunks in the art of Fusion. Meanwhile, Gohan, having been healed in Supreme Kai's world, tries to remove the legendary Z-Sword to use in the fight against Majin Buu!

It Came Ou~t!! The Legendary Z Sword Majin Buu launches into a feeding frenzy, transforming an entire town's population into chocolate! Gohan draws the ancient Z-Sword, Goku struggles to teach Goten and Trunks the art of Fusion, and an unlikely hero is asked to join the fight!

West City is Targeted! Stop, Majin Buu!! As Goten and Trunks train to stop the vicious Majin Buu, Idasa's jaded mother tells Babidi exactly where Trunks lives! The Z-Fighters must now find a way to stop the evil wizard before he reaches Capsule Corp!

An Astounding, Great Transformation!! Super Saiyan 3 Trunks searches frantically for the lost dragon radar, and Goku powers-up to an unimaginable level: Super Saiyan 3! Will this newfound strength be enough to stop Majin Buu from destroying West City?

Bye-Bye, Babidi!! Majin Buu Rebels Goku uses his new Super Saiyan 3 abilities to combat the evil Majin Buu, buying Trunks the time he needs to locate the missing Dragon Radar. But now that Goku has started the fight, he may not be able to escape!

Absurdly Awful Looking?! The Special Training Transformation Pose Liberated from his master, Majin Buu becomes even more destructive than before, wiping out entire cities in mere seconds! Earth's only hope now rests on the shoulders of two young warriors: Goten and Trunks!

See You Later, Everybody!! Goku Returns to the Afterlife Tensions rise for Goten and Trunks as their duel with Majin Buu approaches. Meanwhile, Buu prepares for the upcoming battle by building himself a home! Elsewhere, Goku bids a poignant farewell as he finally returns to Other World.

Where is Gohan?! Training in the Kaiōshin Realm While Trunks and Goten continue their quest to perfect the Fusion Technique, Gohan seeks to master the Z-Sword. Back on Earth, an encounter with a blind boy reveals that there is another side to the belligerent Buu!
You're Kidding, Right?! The Z Sword is Broken Gohan breaks the Z Sword in training, but from within it comes a new Kai, with a new technique!

The Birth of a Superhuman Warrior!! His Name is Gotenks After many comical misfires, Trunks and Goten finally perfect the Fusion technique, and Gotenks is born! Defying Piccolo's command, the super-kid immediately leaves to go fight Majin Buu! Is Gotenks ready for the fight of his young life?

The Final Weapon is Engaged?! Satan Will Save the Earth As Majin Buu continues to terrorize humanity, a lone savior appears: Mr. Satan! But his Megaton punch won't be enough to stop the monster, but this unlikely hero may have a few surprises in store for Buu!

I've Stopped Killing!! Majin Buu's Good Boy Declaration While the Z-Fighters continue training in preparation for their battle with Majin Buu, Mr. Satan devises some sneakier plans to take the villain down. But will he even need to carry them out? Is Majin Buu having a change of heart?

Run Away, Satan!! An Angry Majin Buu Emerges When Mr. Satan inspires Majin Buu to give up his evil ways, it seems the professional pretender has really saved the world. But when a deranged madman suddenly spoils Buu's good mood, the pink terror goes on another rampage.

Which One Will Win?! A Good and Evil Boo-Boo Confrontation Good Buu and Evil Buu begin fighting and it seems Evil Buu is much stronger. After a counterattack from Evil Buu the Good Buu turns into chocalate and the Evil Buu eats him and transforms into Super Buu.

A Catastrophe With No Time to Lose!! Earth's Humanity is Exterminated When the new and improved Majin Buu makes a surprise visit to the Lookout to challenge Gotenks, every second becomes a test of survival! And where are Trunks and Goten during the chaos that erupts?... Sound asleep, of course!

The Special Training is a Success!! You're Finished Now, Majin Buu Before he can unleash his fury on the remaining Z-Fighters, Majin Buu is coaxed into the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Inside, Trunks and Goten are training diligently, but will they have enough time to perfect their new moves before Majin Buu arrives?
The long awaited rematch between Majin Buu and Gotenks begins! But when Gotenks' fighting techniques come up short, he is forced to improvise - resulting in some of the craziest attack moves ever!

The battle between Gotenks and Majin Buu rages on inside the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. On the outside, family and friends wait anxiously for Gotenks and Piccolo to reappear. Can they successfully defeat Majin Buu and make it out alive?

Powered by his insatiable hunger, Majin Buu escapes the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, leaving Piccolo and Gotenks trapped inside. Krillin and the gang are forced to fight the monster on their own. Will Buu finally make a meal out of the good guys?

Super Saiyan 3 Gotenks continues his fight with Majin Buu, and the Lookout is caught in the crossfire! As Gotenks turns up the power, so does Majin Buu - and by the time it's over, one of them will be in way over his head!

Gohan continues his training on the World of the Kais. Meanwhile, Gotenks briefly takes the upper hand in the battle with Majin Buu before his techniques begin to fall apart. Will Gohan be ready in time to step in and finish the fight?

When Gotenks' fusion unravels, it appears the end has finally come for Goten and Trunks. But just as things seem their worst, Gohan descends on the scene with his newly awakened powers! Finally, the tables are turning on Majin Buu!

After being dominated on the battlefield, Majin Buu blows himself up in a desperate attempt to destroy Gohan! But is this just a ploy? Gohan seems to think so! Is Majin Buu plotting an ambush or simply trying to buy a little time?

Majin Buu reappears, ready for battle, but rather than continue his fight against Gohan, Buu stages a clever deception to absorb Gotenks and Piccolo. With the wisdom of Piccolo and the power of Super Saiyan Gotenks, Buu transforms into "Super Buu!"

After absorbing Piccolo and Gotenks, Majin Buu's powers have increased exponentially! Armed with some new tricks, Majin Buu is poised for global destruction. Now that Gohan is alone and weakening, is there anyone who can stop the monster?

Goku watches helplessly from Other World as Majin Buu sets his sights on Gohan. Luckily the Old Kai reveals a secret source of power that could save the day. Is Goku ready to bond with his son and put an end to Majin Buu's reign of terror?

After Majin Buu absorbs Gohan, Goku's plan to join forces with his son is ruined. But an unlikely ally arrives on the scene-Vegeta. Will the Saiyan Prince put aside his differences and agree to merge with Goku?

The bodies of Goku and Vegeta join to form a new Saiyan warrior. The monster Majin Buu is impressed by the strength of his new opponent, but refuses to take him seriously. Will Majin Buu's arrogance be his undoing?

The newly-formed Saiyan warrior Super Vegito matches Majin Buu punch for punch. But the monster's new opponent stirs up an uncontrollable anger within the very heart of the beast. Will Majin Buu's frenzy mean the end of planet Earth?

The battle rages on between Vegito and Majin Buu! The Super Saiyan Combo seems to have the fight well in hand. But is Vegito tempting fate by toying with Buu? What terrible tricks does the wily, pink monster still have up his sleeve?

Having been reduced to a coffee-flavored candy, it seems nothing can stop Vegito from being consumed by the evil Majin Buu. But when the gumdrop fights back, Buu realizes that the battle is far from over!

When Majin Buu absorbs Vegito, the fused Saiyan separates into Goku and Vegeta once again. Deep within the villain, they reveal their plan to rescue Gohan and the others. Can the duo survive the digestive process and carry out their mission?

Dangers abound as Goku and Vegeta continue their search for Gohan and inside of Majin Buu's body! After meeting some disgusting bedfellows, they finally find what they're looking for as they enter Majin Buu's head!

Goku and Vegeta reunite the others only to be attacked by Majin Buu! The showdown proves that fighting Buu inside his own head is a mind-bending experience. Can Goku and Vegeta survive in this twisted house of horrors where all is Buu?

When Super Buu begins to mutate once more, Goku and Vegeta make an escape. But what is it that awaits should they manage to escape? The sinister Kid Buu is revealed and proves to be more deadly and psychotic than all previous incarnations.

After the chords of attachment to the roly-poly Buu are cut by Vegeta, Majin Buu should mutate into a much weaker form. But instead he gets even stronger! This baffles everyone but Kibito Kai, who discloses Majin Buu's bizarre history!

With Earth erased from existence, Majin Buu begins his search for Goku and Vegeta, leaving entire worlds destroyed in his wake. But when Buu's hunt leads him to the World of the Kais, Goku and Vegeta draw the line!

With Majin Buu ready for a fight, Kibito Kai is stunned to see Goku and Vegeta playing a game of Rock, Paper, Scissors! Rather than use the Fusion Technique to join their powers, the duo has decided to fight Buu one at a time!
When Super Saiyan 3 Goku collapses from exhaustion, Vegeta enters the fight, but he doesn't last long! Just as Majin Buu is about to deliver the deathblow, Goku makes a comeback!

Goku's powers are fading, and he must end the battle before it's too late! Enter Vegeta, who begins a furious battle with Buu to buy Goku the time needed to gather energy. Outclassed by his opponent, can the Saiyan Prince survive!?
When Vegeta falls, Mr. Satan steps in to take up the challenge! It appears the wannabe hero has signed his death warrant, but when Buu attempts to attack, the monster is crippled by agony!

As good Majin Buu wages an all-out war against his evil counterpart, Vegeta asks Dende to summon the Dragon on the new Planet Namek. With the good Buu's power dwindling, will Vegeta have enough time to carry out the final phase of his plan?

Goku awaits the arrival of the Earthlings collective energy to vitalize the Spirit Bomb, but the energy isn't coming! Have the people of the Earth turned a deaf ear to Vegeta's plea for help at this most critical hour?
People of earth are united in order to help Goku to prepare his final attack to defeat Buu and honored Vegeta's sacrifice.

After the good Buu and Mr. Satan free Vegeta, Goku launches the Spirit Bomb! Unfortunately, the weary Saiyan doesn't have enough power to deliver the blast, and Buu sends it right back at him! Will Goku be destroyed by his own attack?

When Goku and his companions return to Earth after defeating Majin Buu, they are welcomed with open arms. But nobody is happy to see the good Buu! Can Mr. Satan's pink pal manage to fit into society? Or is he destined to become an outcast?
Goku is late for his own party... he's busy looking after some pterodactyl eggs.

Grandpa Goku! I Am Pan!! Goku intends to participate in the World Martial Arts Tournament. It seems a mysterious fighter has caught his eye. Of course, Vegeta, Trunks, Goten, and Pan will fight as well.
I Am Uub! Now 10 Years Old, the Former Majin?! The World Martial Arts Tournament gets underway. Goku is paired up with the mystery fighter who Goku claims is the reincarnation of Majin Buu.
Even Stronger!! Goku's Dream is Super-Huge Goku takes Uub on as his student, and bids goodbye to his family and friends as he embarks on a new adventure.
